SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count, r.parent_id, r.reply_to_nickname FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.dish_id = #{dishId} AND r.is_hidden = 0 AND r.parent_id IS NULL
AND r.images IS NOT NULL AND r.images != '' AND r.images != '[]'
ORDER BY r.useful_count DESC, r.created_at DESC ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count, r.parent_id, r.reply_to_nickname FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_hidden = 0 AND r.parent_id IS NULL
ORDER BY r.useful_count DESC, r.created_at DESC ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count, r.parent_id, r.reply_to_nickname FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN dish d ON r.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.stall_id = #{stallId} AND r.is_hidden = 0 AND r.parent_id IS NULL
AND r.images IS NOT NULL AND r.images != '' AND r.images != '[]'
ORDER BY r.useful_count DESC, r.created_at DESC ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count, r.parent_id, r.reply_to_nickname FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id JOIN dish d ON r.dish_id = d.id JOIN stall s ON d.stall_id = s.id WHERE s.canteen_id = #{canteenId} AND r.is_hidden = 0 AND r.parent_id IS NULL
AND r.images IS NOT NULL AND r.images != '' AND r.images != '[]'
ORDER BY r.useful_count DESC, r.created_at DESC ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM review r JOIN dish d ON r.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.stall_id = #{stallId} AND r.is_hidden = 0
SELECT nickname FROM user WHERE id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id, dish_id, user_nickname, user_avatar, rating, content, images_json, created_at, useful_count, parent_id, reply_to_nickname FROM ( SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.dish_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.avatar AS user_avatar, r.rating, r.content, r.images AS images_json, r.created_at, r.useful_count AS useful_count, r.parent_id, r.reply_to_nickname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.parent_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM review r JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.parent_id IN #{pid} AND r.is_hidden = 0 ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY t.parent_id, t.created_at ASC
SELECT r.parent_id AS parentId, COUNT(*) AS total FROM review r WHERE r.parent_id IN #{pid} AND r.is_hidden = 0 GROUP BY r.parent_id
SELECT r.id FROM review r WHERE r.parent_id IN #{pid}
